branches.description:
Each experiment needs to specify one or more branches. Each branch has a name
and a ratio. An enrolled user is assigned one branch randomly, with the
probabilities weighted per the ratio.

name.description:
The branch name. This is what product code uses to decide which branch logic to
execute.

ratio.description: The branches ratio is the probabilistic weight for random branch assignment.

branches.title: Branches

buckets.description:
Each user is assigned a random bucket from 0 to 999. Select the bucket ranges
here to control the enrolled population size.
buckets.title: Buckets

match.description:
A list of optional matchers, which allow restricting the experiment to e.g.
specific application ids.

app_display_version.description: The applications version number. A regex. E.g.: '47.0a1', '46.0'

app_id.description:
Match specific application ids. A regex. E.g.:
^org.mozilla.fennec|org.mozilla.firefox_beta|org.mozilla.firefox$'

app_max_version.description: The application's maximum version number. E.g.: '47.0.11', '46.0'

app_min_version.description: The application's minimum version number. E.g.: '47.0.11', '46.0'

debug_tags.description:
Target specific debug tags only. This allows testing of experiments for only
specific active users for QA etc.

items.description: A debug tag set through the libraries debug activity.
items.title: Debug tag

debug_tags.title: Debug tags

locale_country.description: Match country, pulled from the default locale. A regex. E.g.: USA|ITA

locale_language.description: Language, pulled from the default locale. A regex. E.g.: eng|esp

regions.description: Compared with GeoIP lookup, where supported.
regions.title: Regions

match.title: Matching
